At 150k/year that's around 12,500/month, so the Erin City Walk 1BR at 21k is over budget. We have a 1BR in MAG 318 at 13,000/month and one in Urban Oasis at 12,500/month, both furnished and all-inclusive. Which one would you like more details on?
